scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Scans the entity registry for entries flagged as orphaned by Home Assistant itself (orphaned_timestamp set). Splits results into "safe" (entity_id not reused anywhere live - includes a ready-to-run remove command) and "dangerous" (entity_id has been reused by a currently live entity - must never be removed by name).

remove.name: Remove
remove.description: Given a list of registry_ids from a prior scan, re-checks the live-entity safety condition and returns the exact shell command(s) to run manually to remove each one. Does not touch the registry itself.

registry_ids.name: Registry IDs
registry_ids.description: List of internal registry ids to generate remove commands for (from scan results).

orphan_safe.title: Orphaned entity: {entity_id}
orphan_safe.description:
This entity from the '{platform}' platform is orphaned (its source integration or config is gone) and its entity_id is not currently used by anything live.

To remove it (stop Home Assistant first):

`{remove_command}`

orphan_dangerous.title: Orphaned entity (name reused - manual action needed): {entity_id}
orphan_dangerous.description: An orphaned registry entry (registry id: {registry_id}) shares its entity_id with a currently LIVE entity. This cannot be safely removed by name. Call safe_orphan_cleaner.remove with registry_ids: ['{registry_id}'] to get the exact safe command.
